description: This file defines the Schedule class within the OrangeHRM framework, managing scheduled tasks for the console commands, including adding, retrieving, and filtering tasks based on due status.

classes.name: Schedule
classes.description: Provides scheduling management for console commands, including task addition, retrieval, filtering, and unique ID generation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes Schedule with console and output interfaces.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new task based on CommandInfo, throws exception for specific command.

methods.name: getDueTasks
methods.description: Filters and returns tasks that are due based on the provided timezone.

methods.name: generateUniqueId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for tasks, ensuring no duplication within current tasks.
